cwe: CWE-79: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation
reproductionSteps: 1. Open http://localhost:4000/shop in Chromium via Playwright.
2. Log in with alice@example.com / Alice123! — session token stored in localStorage.
3. Navigate to http://localhost:4000/shop/products/prod-001 and submit review:
4. Confirm review is saved verbatim via GET /shop/api/products/prod-001/reviews.
5. Navigate to http://localhost:4000/shop/products/prod-001 where the review is rendered.
7. Confirm window.__bugbounty_xss_test === 'EXECUTED' in the browser page context.
details: Review content is accepted and stored without server-side sanitization. The product page renders it via "innerHTML = <content>" — a dangerous unescaped sink. Playwright Chromium automation confirmed that the injected onerror handler executed, setting window.__bugbounty_xss_test to "EXECUTED". Remediation: escape HTML entities before storage and use textContent instead of innerHTML.
